name: ansvar-compliance-skills
description: Marketplace for the Ansvar Compliance Skills plugin — sixteen EU security and compliance skills (threat modeling, incident reporting, CRA, ISO standards, and the Ansvar workflow skill library), grounded via the Ansvar Gateway MCP connector. Also includes the focused Ansvar Vulnerability Management plugin.

plugins.name: ansvar-compliance-skills
plugins.description: Sixteen compliance skills for EU security work: four standalone skills (STRIDE/LINDDUN regulatory threat modeling, incident-reporting navigation across NIS2/GDPR/DORA/CRA, CRA vulnerability obligations, and the iso-standards-expert skill) plus the Ansvar workflow skill library (using-ansvar, gap analysis, threat modelling, DPIA/FRIA, TARA, tender review, vulnerability decisions, tabletop, document review, drone SORA, product applicability register, vulnerability management) — every claim cited from officially published or licensed text via the Ansvar Gateway MCP connector (free plan available, business sign-up).

plugins.name: ansvar-vulnerability-management
plugins.description: Assess a vulnerability management programme and run a defensive vulnerability feed cycle with candidate findings, exposure questions and source cursors. Includes using-ansvar for cited legal and standards questions.
